items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: And Red Bowman as my first trumpet player.

ctx.x: At that time, he was with me, I'll show you the picture. And I had Eddie Powers who was in the man always on time. I had a fine band. I had Tony Almarico as my hot man. And Red Bowman as my first trumpet player. Wyatt Sharp as my trabumpa. He's not on the Jerry L.A. Do you know him?
